operation.title: Operation / Oficina de produção
operation.diorama: A compact cutaway urban workshop with concrete tile floor, exposed pipes, magenta-teal graffiti rolling shutter, crown tags, rough timber workstation, modular storage, abstract stylized fictional plants, warm practical lights and dusk through a barred window.
operation.visual_story: Resourceful improvised workspace that evolves with player progress. Avoid realistic cultivation instructions.

market.title: Market / Banca de rua
market.diorama: A dense improvised street kiosk at night, corrugated awning, hand-painted graffiti, colorful abstract packages and crates, pixel-tiled pavement, warm stall light and cool neon spill.
market.visual_story: Commercial choices read through abstract props, never real-world illicit transaction instructions.

city.title: City / Bairro em miniatura
city.diorama: Multi-level fictional Rio-adjacent dense neighborhood, stacked colorful houses, painted rooftop walls, cables, narrow staircases, mural alley, streetlamps and tiny pools of tropical night color; clearly a single explorable 3D city chunk.
city.visual_story: Dense lived-in fictional neighborhood, no stereotyped postcard skyline and no real map instructions.

archive.title: Archive / Memória
archive.diorama: Small graffiti-marked urban archive room, filing shelves, chunky documents, stickered drawers, battered desk, framed anonymous historical photos, pixelated amber desk lamp, handmade crown insignia.
archive.visual_story: Collective urban memory as an interactable place. All decorative text illegible placeholders for authored in-engine UI.

campaign.title: Campaign / Sala de planejamento
campaign.diorama: Isometric planning room with a large physical neighborhood strategy map, taped hand-drawn symbols, portable radio, chunky marker pens, torn stickers, graffiti wall and modular upgrade boards.
campaign.visual_story: Game campaign progression through environmental storytelling, not an electoral campaign endorsement.

institutional.title: Institutional / Escritório fictício
institutional.diorama: A compact satirical fictional municipal office with chipped tile, generic cabinets, battered counters, paper stacks, fluorescent practical lamp and restrained mural intrusion that signals the game's art identity.
institutional.visual_story: Fictional institutional systems only; no real politicians, partisan badges, or persuasive campaign imagery.

narrative.title: Narrative / Laje ao entardecer
narrative.diorama: Intimate rooftop conversation space overlooking fictional dense rooftops at hot magenta-orange sunset, handmade mural, rooftop bench, scattered paper, hanging cable silhouettes, tropical plants in old paint buckets.
narrative.visual_story: Human-scale place for story beats without invented canonical characters or events.

finale-selection.title: Finale Selection / Três caminhos
finale-selection.diorama: A compact defiant street-art crossroads cutaway: three visually different glowing garage doorways with distinct physical symbols, floor stencil crown and worn concrete, colored bounce light, strong spacing between touch targets.
finale-selection.visual_story: Choices are equally visible; color alone must not encode meaning; preserve canon-defined outcomes.

finale-coda.title: Finale Coda / Legado
finale-coda.diorama: An atmospheric stylized street-art memorial court, candlelike abstract warm point lights, crown mural and cracked cobblestone tiles, sky-colored urban shadows, vivid teal-pink mural distinct from every other finale room.
finale-coda.visual_story: An evocative, non-religious-by-default abstract closure until LORE confirms canon.

finale-handoff.title: Finale Handoff / Travessia
finale-handoff.diorama: Pixel-art graffiti urban loading-bay threshold with dramatic striped floor light, partially opened metal doors, stacked abstract equipment crates, a single strong passage destination, distinct from coda and recap.
finale-handoff.visual_story: Transition visually legible at phone size; do not suggest unapproved canon or operational distribution methods.

finale-recap.title: Finale Recap / Resultados
finale-recap.diorama: Street-art-meets-chunky-pixel dashboard corner with a crown graffiti backdrop, multiple distinct physical trophy or record objects, several readable blank display panels reserved for actual in-engine statistics.
finale-recap.visual_story: Visualized achievements and progression; never bake fake numeric results or invented UI lettering into concept art.
